title: Holographic Dual of PT Symmetric BCFT
abstract: Constructs the holographic dual of a 2d CFT with non-Hermitian but PT-symmetric boundary conditions via AdS/BCFT with an imaginary scalar field localized on an end-of-the-world brane. Predicts a spontaneous PT-breaking transition as the non-Hermitian coupling grows and entanglement-entropy growth exceeding standard Cardy-state results.
key_claims: PT-symmetric (non-Hermitian) boundary criticality in 2d CFT admits a controlled geometric dual: AdS/BCFT with an imaginary scalar on an end-of-the-world brane.
Predicts a spontaneous PT-breaking transition as the non-Hermitian coupling grows -- directly analogous to the PT-breaking edge that closed the project's ED route at N<=16 (SIM-055).
Predicts entanglement-entropy growth exceeding standard Cardy-state results -- a concrete, checkable validation signature for a future non-Hermitian MERA.
relevance_note: WATCH (deferred from scan #13, catalogued scan #14). Holographic counterpart of exactly the structure HYP-028 needs. Two payoffs: (1) legitimizes the non-Hermitian MERA target -- if PT-symmetric boundary criticality has a controlled bulk geometry, a non-Hermitian tensor-network discretization of it is discretizing a genuine geometry, the same MERA-equals-discrete-AdS logic behind the alpha=4 force program; (2) supplies concrete validation observables (PT-breaking transition location, super-Cardy entanglement growth) for any future non-Hermitian MERA. Takayanagi-group provenance; tooling/legitimation reference for the HYP-028 thread, not a competitor result.
anchor_contradiction: None. Reinforces (does not challenge) the PT-breaking-edge phenomenology behind the SIM-055 ED closure; no contact with alpha=4 or transport anchors.
